rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the room or area where food is prepared.

example.english: Someone is cooking in the kitchen.

rows.note: Use this for a named cuisine or culinary tradition, as in 法國菜 for French cuisine.

example.english: The Sichuan kitchen at this restaurant is really good.
